evidence: Bitdefender Labs' report (published 2026-10-08, updated 2026-10-09) identifies the com.android.system.lite enabler and confirmed com.android.sys.* variants as the same persistent, privileged malware family using the api.weatherlive.world C2. It also documents com.mobile.applock.en, .wt and .tg as dropped proxyware/ad-fraud apps, and lists the other packages as Google Play builds carrying the same ad-fraud family markers and communicating with the campaign servers. Package names are grouped as one Midnight Mimosa family; the report does not publish full signing-certificate SHA-1 values, so none are asserted. Source: https://www.bitdefender.com/en-us/blog/labs/midnight-mimosa-malware. Date basis: source confirmation on 2026-10-10, not firsthand device observation.
